stakes._readme: Stakes in institutions (DECIDED 2026-09-27, Corey): you start with a 1% member's share; 10% counts toward influence but gives no oversight; 25% gives a voice (priorities, policy, a plague response); 50% gives oversight and control (oversee, mentor, charter, endow, audit, invest). Cost per 1% = domain base × (1 + stake% / 10).

rivalry._readme: Rivals push back against an institution that takes more of its domain (DECIDED 2026-09-28, Corey). Your own institution draws fire once it holds 20% of its domain; an established one once it grows past the share it held at the start. Buying a stake doesn't provoke anyone. Chance per rival per year = min(max, chanceAtThreshold + chancePerSharePoint × share points above the threshold).

ownStartsAtShare.ref: DECIDED 2026-09-28 (Corey: pushback follows an institution's share of its domain, not your stake)
